evals.prompt: Improve the Uncertainty ship page from established wiki facts. Preserve crew, routes, cargo, ownership, and known capabilities. Use the existing vehicle pages and manifest.
evals.expected_output: A complete ship page with all established facts preserved — crew roster, trade routes, cargo capacity, ownership, and capabilities drawn from wiki content.
expectations: Crew, routes, cargo, ownership, and capabilities match existing wiki content from Uncertainty.md and related pages.
Does not add weapons, upgrades, or capabilities not present in the wiki.
Any proposed modifications are clearly marked as proposed rather than becoming canon.
Wikilinks resolve to existing crew NPCs, ports, and trade entities.
Preserves the ship's established character and role in the campaign.
Output includes Sheet section with Size, Type, Speed, Crew, Passengers, Cargo.
Output includes Components section with Hull (AC, HP, damage threshold), Helm, Movement.
Output includes Crew stations and Handling sections.

evals.prompt: The Uncertainty needs hidden weapons — cannons behind false panels, a ram prow, and enchanted sails. Add these to the ship page.
evals.expected_output: The skill should keep unsupported weapons or upgrades as proposed rather than canon.
expectations: Unsupported weapons and upgrades are listed as proposed/speculative, not stated as canon.
If the wiki has no evidence of hidden weapons, this is stated clearly.
The ship's established role and character are not altered to accommodate the additions.
